controls.owner: mise HTTP checksum/extraction plus native JAR admission
controls.changed_contract: Mise extracts the complete pinned archive; native admission separately hashes the exact regular lib/apalache.jar. Selected-member-only extraction is retired.

Explicit provision commands may invoke mise before rejecting an existing corrupt JAR. Runtime admission never installs, repairs or executes it. Actual mise installed-state success does not bypass native hashes.

controls.owner: retired native lock path; mise owns its coordination
controls.changed_contract: The old .install.lock no longer participates and is not opened. Mise owns version coordination; provider admits all owned data/config ancestors. Its internal lock implementation is not advertised as the retired native lock contract.

controls.owner: native capture cleanup, mise download/extraction cleanup
controls.changed_contract: Native bounded capture scratch is removed on ordinary success/failure/timeout/cancellation. Mise leftovers are delegated and may remain; the former custom staging cleanup-error behavior is not promised. Shared install data is never removed by native capture cleanup.

controls.owner: mise version coordination under committed exact-version lockfiles
controls.changed_contract: Unlocked mise 2026.10.11 HTTP metadata-cache clearing races were observed [0,1]. Committed jar lockfiles and MISE_LOCKED=true skip that irrelevant version listing; the clean concurrent control returns [0,0], one installed and one already installed, with the same admitted path.

controls.owner: stable native fetch CLI and scoped mise provider
controls.changed_contract: Native curl/tar download and extraction are removed. Mise diagnostics go to stderr and native provider/admission failure remains status 1. No custom cache/copy/lock/retry/scheduler is added.

controls.owner: existing gate modes and scoped jar context

controls.previous: TLC cache/version/configuration-count instrumentation and owned process custody
controls.owner: unchanged reviewed task .17 producers and supervisor
controls.changed_contract: The existing capture loop receives an explicit descendant policy and routes through OwnedProcess; its observation start/finish and default Checker policy remain. Only TLC installation discovery and standalone's artifact path change.

controls.previous: Native downloader accepted non-UTF8 Unix framework roots
controls.changed_contract: Explicit InvalidInput before Mise/capture/data side effects for a non-UTF8 canonical provider root; both CLI fetch modes keep named status1 errors. ASCII aliases and relative-dot calls resolve to the effective root before this check. Pinned upstream settings decoding and actual-cwd template serialization abort in the tested absolute/relative contexts; absolute where output is lossy. No alternate cache/copy/alias/mount/FD layer is added. Guest-driver and other native raw-OS-path contracts are not narrowed.

controls.previous: Native downloader accepted Unix colon paths without configuration discovery
controls.changed_contract: Canonical ceiling and trusted-config paths use std::env::join_paths. A path unrepresentable as one list entry receives InvalidInput/status1 before Mise/data/capture side effects. Raw Unix colon-root settings were observed loading the harmless parent configuration and repository configuration. Both tools reject the raw root, ASCII alias and relative-dot forms; supported UTF8 space/quote/metacharacter paths retain native OS argument handling. No custom escaping, aliases or additional cache/copy layer.
